events.content:
The production build succeeds. The fonts are now added entirely inside `BlogHeader.tsx`. What changed in `app/BlogHeader.tsx`: - Imported `Playfair_Display` and `Roboto` from `next/font/google` (Next.js's built-in, self-hosted font loader — no external `` tags or CSS files needed). - Configured each font with `subsets: ['latin']`, sensible weights, `display: 'swap'`, and a dedicated CSS variable (`--font-playfair-display`, `--font-roboto`). - Applied the font variables on the `
` and used the variables via inline `fontFamily` styles — `Playfair Display` (700) for the `

` main heading and `Roboto` (300) for the `

` subtitle. All font definitions and styling logic live within `BlogHeader` itself; `page.tsx` and `layout.tsx` were left untouched. Verification: - `npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, no errors. - `npm run build` → `✓ Compiled successfully`, all 3 static pages generated, exit 0. One note: `next/font/google` fetches the font files at build time, so builds require network access to Google Fonts (the build above succeeded, so this environment has it).
